about: Server-Sent Events of the app, from the Python host in demo mode, while a question was typed. Each message is 'event: <name>' and 'data: <compact JSON>'; the first message of each stream also carries 'retry: 3000'.

event.note: data depends on the kind (Brain.java): present/seated (robot online/offline), distance_m (arrived, approached, sat_down), breath_rate/heart_rate (vitals_acquired), seated_s (stood_up, still_long), nothing (left, vitals_lost)

vitals.pending: C3, W2: 1 Hz, GET /api/vitals's current object

approval.pending: C4, W4: on every change of an approval

sample.summary: Draft a reply to the plumber saying Thursday works

/api/senses/stream.about: The Senses screen's stream (the Java host only): the scene 5 times a second, the devices and a summary once a second, and as they come the voice's level (at most 20 a second), the ears' diagnostics (hearing), utterance, voice, camera and task, with the shapes of /api/stream's.

reasoning: No presence sensor: the lidar sees shapes, but cannot tell a person from furniture.
The camera is never used for presence: it takes a picture only when asked.

senses.note: thinks.reasoning (the reasoning levels, asked of the model server) is refreshed every 30 s: the messages before the first refresh have none, the app keeps the last one, GET /api/senses always has it
